name: Alpine Club of Pakistan (ACP)
role: National governing body for mountaineering, rock climbing, and adventure sports in Pakistan. Oversees Karakoram peak permits, porter welfare regulations, and rescue operations.

name: The Alpine Club (UK)
role: The world's first mountaineering club, founded in London. Played the preeminent role in the Golden Age of Alpinism, pioneer Himalayan expeditions, and publishes the renowned Alpine Journal.

name: American Alpine Club (AAC)
role: Pioneering North American climbing organization championing conservation, climbing access, global rescue insurance, and publishing the American Alpine Journal (AAJ) and Accidents in North American Climbing.

name: International Climbing and Mountaineering Federation (UIAA)
role: The supreme international governing federation representing millions of mountaineers worldwide. Establishes universal safety standards for ropes, helmets, carabiners, and avalanche beacons.

name: Club Alpin Français (FFCAM)
role: Manages over 120 high-altitude mountain refuges across the Mont Blanc massif, Écrins, and Pyrenees, leading safety instruction and environmental preservation.

name: Club Alpino Italiano (CAI)
role: Organized the historic 1954 expedition that conquered K2; maintains 700+ alpine shelters and thousands of kilometers of marked alpine trails.
